costume.name: Garden Beekeeper
costume.description: Cream cotton utility layers and a mesh veil hood, softened by tan gloves and a tiny bee brooch.
costume.alt: Cream beekeeper jacket with mesh veil hood, cream utility trousers, tan gloves, brown boots, and a fabric bee brooch

pieces.name: Beekeeper jacket with mesh veil
queries: cream cotton beekeeping jacket round veil
pieces.styleNotes: Pale cream utility jacket with an attached mesh veil. Round veils preserve the reference shape best. These are real specialist jackets, but the costume assembly is not verified protective beekeeping clothing. Budget hood is a fencing shape rather than the reference brimmed round veil. White and pale polycotton shades replace exact cream; mesh and pocket layouts vary.

matches.reason: One white 250 GSM canvas-cotton jacket, removable round mesh veil, YKK zippers, elastic waist and cuffs, and two chest pockets. Large and Extra-Large are the only current variants. White is brighter than the cream reference; pocket details differ. US USD storefront. Public variant feed confirms availability despite generic sold-out text in the page template. No bee-protection claim is made for this costume.

One light cotton beekeeping jacket with its self-supported mesh hood. Pale off-white appearance; fencing-style hood differs from the reference round-brim hat. Only the listed sizes are available at $55. Sold by US beekeeping supplier. This shopping selection is for costume styling; it does not establish bee-sting protection for the assembled outfit.

One pale polycotton jacket with round mesh veil and three-layer ventilation panels; canvas carrying case included. The blend and larger mesh sections differ from the reference cotton jacket. Large is unavailable and excluded. US USD listing. Do not infer bee-sting protection for the full costume from this specialist garment.

pieces.name: Cream utility trousers
queries: natural cotton double knee work pants
pieces.styleNotes: Cream or natural off-white full-length work trousers with practical pockets. Painter pants preserve utility detail but do not reproduce all cargo flaps and elastic cuffs. No option exactly reproduces the reference cargo flap pockets and elastic ankle cuffs.

matches.reason: One pair, Natural Drill only: relaxed double-knee painter trousers in 10 oz 100% cotton. Tool pockets and hammer loop supply the utility look; there are no large flap cargo pockets. Listing specifies button-fastening cuffs rather than the reference elastic cuffs. Four available waist/32-inch length combinations only. US independent merchant.

One pair of cream straight-leg carpenter pants with elastic waist, utility pockets, belt loops, and hammer loop. No thigh cargo flaps or elastic ankle cuffs. Merchant composition lists 100% cotton, while introductory copy calls the fabric TC twill; composition wording is inconsistent. All five listed sizes are available. US storefront offers domestic shipping.

One pair of natural off-white fitted work pants in 13 oz 100% cotton Cone Mills denim, with double front panels and eight pockets. Heavier denim and straight hems differ from the reference cream cargo trousers. Only 28-inch, 36-inch, and 38-inch waist labels currently available; compare merchant garment measurements. Maker states dispatch within seven business days; no delivery date is promised.

pieces.name: Small fabric bee brooch
